payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerates possible smaller side lengths from min(a,b) to ceil(sqrt(6n)), computes the required larger side as ceil(6n/x) subject to >= max(a,b), and picks the pair with minimal area.
payload.rationale: Exhaustively searches over a bounded 1D domain to find optimal dimensions. This aligns with complete search, and backtracking is the nearest available subtype, though no recursion is used.
